verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents an import or migration feature, such as importing boards or tasks from Trello, Asana, Jira or spreadsheets when switching tools. The closest items are adjacent rather than the capability itself: ongoing 2-way sync integrations, and a GraphQL API and SDKs that a developer could use to build an importer. A community post mentions a team moving from Trello to monday.com but says nothing about how its data was carried over.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can import my data from another tool when switching over
